summary: Validated Fase 1 webhook detection fix. Backend endpoint GET /api/integrations/prestashop/list correctly returns webhook_active and last_webhook_at fields with hydrated Pydantic defaults. UI (Configuración → Integraciones) correctly renders conditional badges: yellow 'Webhook Inactivo' for tricomar.cl (webhook_active=false) and green 'Webhook Activo' for tricomarpets.cl (webhook_active=true). End-to-end data flow (DB → API → UI conditional rendering) is working correctly.
passed: Login with hola@tricomar.cl works and returns JWT token
GET /api/integrations/prestashop/list returns webhook_active field for both integrations (tricomar.cl=false, tricomarpets.cl=true)
UI list view badge 'Webhook Inactivo' (yellow) visible for tricomar.cl integration
UI list view badge 'Webhook Activo' (green with pulse dot) visible for tricomarpets.cl integration
Both integrations show independent, correct webhook states, confirming the migrate_webhook_active.py migration and the /list hydration fix work as expected
